cast: The Devas; The Asuras; Vāsuki, the serpent
action: The Ocean of Milk from above: the mountain turning in white water, and two lines of figures running out to either horizon on one serpent.
dialogue: Narration (V.O.): They were made to pull the same rope, and not one of them could see what was holding the mountain up.
sound: A low bronze drone, one struck bell. No wind.
houdini: Milk-ocean surface: viscous white FLIP, radial wake from the rod, foam ring. Hero sim.
nuke: Haze pass over distance; the horizon lines never resolve into individual faces.
staging: Mountain at world centre; the two lines run out to 2 km either side. Camera 90 m up, 300 m back from the rod.

action: Blistered hands close on the serpent's body, knuckles white, the skin of the palm split.
sound: Rope-creak of scale on scale; breath.
houdini: Serpent scale displacement, sweat and blood micro-detail.
nuke: Shallow depth; keep the far line soft.

action: An Asura's face at the serpent's head, teeth set, smoke coughing past him.
sound: A cough of smoke, deep.
houdini: Smoke puff from the serpent's mouth, interactive with the face.
nuke: Smoke element in front of frame; warm key from nothing visible.

action: From the waterline the mountain spins, and nothing that can be seen is holding it up.
sound: Stone grinding on something that does not sound like stone.
houdini: Mountain rotation, water shear at the base, a shell-back barely readable under the surface.
nuke: Hold Kūrma at the edge of legibility — he must not read as a creature yet.

action: A black stain crosses the milk-white water faster than a man can run; fish turn white and float up behind it.
dialogue: Narration (V.O.): The first thing the ocean gave them was not the prize.
sound: Everything else drops out. A hiss, very wide.
houdini: Hālāhala spread: black dye advection across the FLIP surface, dead-fish scatter in the wake.
nuke: Crush the blacks in the stain only; the milk stays at 0.9 and does not clip.

action: Both armies drop the rope and run along the shore, gods and demons mixed together in the same direction.
sound: Feet on wet shingle, no voices.
houdini: Crowd run cycles, shared agent library; wet-sand footstrike.
nuke: Motion blur long, 270-degree shutter on this one cut.

action: At the edge of the water a fisher child stays where she is, one hand held out toward the dark.
sound: Water at ankle height. One breath held.
houdini: Shoreline interaction at her feet; the black edge arriving.
nuke: Her key is the last warm light in the movement.

action: The black water reaches her feet and goes round them, and does not touch her.
sound: A single low sub drop.
houdini: Dye avoidance at the ankle — art-directed, not physical.
nuke: No stylisation; this must read as something the camera caught.

action: The line of claimants along the shore, every one of them arranged to be chosen, every one of them leaning in.
sound: Shingle, cloth, a crowd holding still badly.
houdini: Crowd variation pass; no two postures repeat in the front rank.
nuke: Long lens compression on the line so it reads as endless.
staging: The line runs 40 m along the waterline, camera 6 m out on the water, long lens.

action: Lakṣmī walks the line with the garland. The camera travels with her, past face after face, and she passes each one.
dialogue: Narration (V.O.): Everything in it was taken. One thing was given.
sound: Her anklets, nothing else.
houdini: Cloth and garland sim on a walking hero asset.
nuke: Faces fall out of focus as she passes them.
staging: She covers 12 m of the line in the shot; the camera dollies level with her at 3 m out.

action: The garland lifts toward a pair of hands that never came forward — and the cut comes before the face.
sound: Flowers. A bell, struck once, far away.
houdini: Garland sim handover between two rigs.
nuke: Frame cuts at the wrist. This is a hard rule, not a preference.
staging: Her at 1.2 m from him, both hands inside a 1 m box. Nothing above the wrist is in the staging.

action: A painted wall in the temple of Ambikā: a mountain, a serpent, a dark flood, a hand at a god's throat, and a goddess walking a line of suitors. A priest sweeps at the far end.
sound: A broom. Temple quiet, with depth behind it.
nuke: The mural is a matte painting projected on geometry; it must survive a 2.4s push.

action: Rukmini's face, lit by nothing but the light off the painted wall. The first time the film looks at her.
sound: Her breath. The broom stops.
nuke: Bounce from the mural is the key. Warm, low, from frame left.

action: Her finger touches the painted figure at the end of the line — the one the goddess stopped for.
sound: Fingertip on dry plaster.
nuke: Paint texture at macro scale; a flake lifts and does not fall.

cast: Rukmī; Bhīṣmaka; Bhīṣmaka's court and its visitors
action: The hall, full. Rukmī announces the match in front of the whole household, pleased with himself.
sound: A room going quiet in stages.
nuke: Practical lamps; long falloff into the colonnade.

action: Rukmī, close, closing the sale.
dialogue: Rukmī: Chedi gives us a border. The cowherd would give us a cousin.
sound: Clean dialogue, no room tone under it.

action: Bhīṣmaka looks down. He loves his son, and the whole room can see it.
sound: Silence held one beat past comfortable.

action: Rukmini watches her father not look up. She does not cry.
She answers her brother without raising her voice, and the camera moves in on the last four words.
dialogue: Rukmini: You can give away a kingdom, brother. Not a woman who has already chosen.
sound: The push is silent; music has not started yet.

action: Ink. The nib goes in, comes out loaded, and makes the first stroke of a letter to a king.
sound: The nib. Bass flute enters here and runs to the end of the movement.
houdini: Ink wet-surface shader, meniscus on the nib.
nuke: Macro depth; the stroke is the only thing in focus in the trailer for 2 seconds.

action: Her room at night, one lamp, the city asleep outside. She is writing fast, which she was never taught to do.
sound: Night outside; a dog, far off.
houdini: Lamp flicker driving the key.
nuke: Single-source lamp; practical-driven grade.

action: Her hand presses the seal into the wax, and holds it there a beat too long.
sound: Wax, and the small sound of a decision.
houdini: Wax deformation and cooling.

action: Her face over the sealed letter. She says the line to nobody, and it is the thesis of the film.
dialogue: Rukmini: They will say a woman was stolen. Let them. I am the one holding the pen.
sound: Flute drops out under the line and comes back after it.

action: The letter goes into the Brahmin's hands and disappears into his clothes.
sound: Cloth.
houdini: Cloth sim on the fold.

action: One man on an enormous road at first light, and the country he has to cross opening out past him in every direction.
sound: Wind at altitude. Percussion is still absent.
houdini: Procedural terrain, scatter, dawn mist in the valleys.
nuke: Atmospheric depth; he is four pixels tall and must still read.
staging: The road runs to the horizon; he is 400 m from camera and 4 px tall. Terrain must carry to 8 km.

action: Feet, then water: he crosses a river with the letter held above his head, dry.
sound: Water at the waist. Breath.
houdini: River FLIP with character interaction; wet-cloth transfer.
nuke: Spray elements; keep the letter clean white in frame.

action: From the wall: a line of dust becomes tents, becomes banners, becomes a country of fires out to the horizon.
sound: Percussion enters on the first frame of this shot. Frame drums, 92 BPM.
houdini: Instanced camp at four LODs; 30,000 fires; dust haze.
nuke: The horizon line is a matte painting handoff past 2 km.
staging: Camp from the wall out to 4 km, fires from 600 m. Camera on the parapet, 30 m above the plain.

props: The chalk marks on the wall of Mathurā
action: The water-carrier stops counting, puts down his bucket, and makes one chalk mark on the wall because there is nothing else to do.
sound: Chalk. The drums continue under it.

action: From the wall the women watch two chariots go in, and the dust closes over them.
sound: Distance: the battle is heard from the wall, not from inside it.
houdini: Battlefield dust volume; chariot dust trails.
nuke: Dust is the wipe that takes the chariots out of frame.

action: Inside the dust: the plough comes through and sweeps the footsoldiers aside like a field being cleared.
sound: Impact, low.
houdini: Crowd ragdoll hand-off on contact; debris.
nuke: Keep Balarama's face readable through the dust — he is not withheld.

action: On the wall, a woman faints and the ones beside her do not catch her.
sound: Cloth and stone.

props: The chalk marks on the wall of Mathurā
action: A chalk stroke on the wall.
sound: Chalk, hard on the beat. The cut pattern from here is strictly on the drum.
nuke: Match-frame the wall across all five inserts; only the marks and the light change.

action: Night, torches coming at the wall.
houdini: Torch instancing, 4,000 lights as cards.

props: The chalk marks on the wall of Mathurā
action: A second chalk stroke beside the first.
A siege tower burning against the wall.
houdini: Pyro: tower fire, embers.

action: A third stroke. The wall is getting crowded.
The camera pulls back off seventeen strokes. The carrier steps back with it, and this time there is no army on the horizon to follow it.
dialogue: Jarasandha (V.O.): Tell Mathurā their king is ash. Tell them who swept it.
sound: Jarasandha's line lands over the pull-back; drums drop to half time under it.

action: The whole hillside alight, fire running up through the trees toward two figures near the top.
sound: Fire at distance — a roar with no crackle in it.
houdini: Hero pyro: wildfire up a slope, 2 km scale, with its own wind.
nuke: Heat distortion over the ridge line.
staging: Hill 2 km across, the two figures at the top ridge, camera 1.5 km out and 60 m up.

action: Balarama looks down the mountain they have run out of. Behind him a figure stands in the smoke with his back to the fire — a silhouette, and nothing more than that.
sound: Smoke, close. A beam goes somewhere below.
houdini: Smoke interaction around two characters.
nuke: Hard rule: the silhouette never resolves. Rim only, no fill, no face.

action: They jump. The camera follows one silhouette against the flames and stops before the ground.
sound: Air. Cut the sound one frame before the camera stops.
houdini: Fire interaction on falling bodies.
nuke: Speed ramp inside the shot; land on the stop.

action: Kālayavana gets off his horse in front of his army, takes off his sword and lets it fall in the dust.
sound: Metal in dust. The drums stop dead.

action: Kālayavana, close, looking at something walking toward him that he does not believe.
dialogue: Kālayavana: No chariot. No bow. No shoes. This is the one they call a god?
sound: Wind only, under the line.

action: The chase: a barefoot man always one step out of reach, shot from behind and below, and never once from the front.
sound: Two sets of feet, one of them not hurrying. Drums return at 132.
houdini: Dust kick per footfall; garland sim.
nuke: Framing cuts at the shoulder for the whole shot.

action: The first gate breaks the surface of the sea. Then a wall, then towers, then terraces of crystal and gold, and the water parts and settles around them as if they had always been there.
sound: The full ensemble arrives here — brass and low strings, the only major-key moment in the trailer.
houdini: The film's largest sim: city emergence, displaced water, sheeting runoff off every surface, whitewater at the walls.
nuke: Wet-surface pass is a separate layer; the gold must not clip at the top.
staging: City emerges 300 m off the shore, 900 m of frontage. Camera on the water at 18 m, craning to 40 m through the shot.

action: On the shore a sailor's hand goes to her mouth.
nuke: Reflected city light on the face is the only source.

action: The kings arrive in a column that does not end: escort after escort, banner after banner, filling the streets of Kuṇḍina.
sound: Drums at full, with conches cutting across them.
houdini: Crowd and horse instancing; banner cloth sim at three LODs.

cast: Jarasandha; Śiśupāla; The coalition of kings
action: In the hall they swear it together and then one by one: if he comes for her, we fight him.
sound: Many voices saying one thing.
nuke: Firelight from below; this is the only low-angle in the movement.

action: Rukmini at a window above them, counting banners. There are too many to count.
sound: The hall, heard through stone.
nuke: Window light; her face half out of it.

action: On the road outside, Balarama arrives with an army behind him and says what he has come for.
dialogue: Balarama: You came for a bride. I came for the war that follows her.
sound: Clean line; drums drop out and come back on the cut.

action: Dressed for a wedding she did not agree to, alone in the room, waiting for a man who has not come. The lamp is lower than it was.
sound: Everything strips back to one room. A single sustained note.
houdini: Heavy ornament and cloth sim at rest.
nuke: The lamp has burned down measurably since T-06; match the two shots.

action: Her hand finds the fold of the dress where something is hidden, and presses it flat.
sound: Cloth and bangles.

cast: Rukmini; The wedding procession; The ring of soldiers
action: A ring of soldiers around one woman, moving down a road lined with people, toward a temple door at the end of it.
sound: Conches, drums, bards — all of it diegetic and all of it slightly too loud.
houdini: Crowd on both sides; flower scatter; dust.
nuke: The temple door is the only still point in the frame.
staging: Road 120 m from palace gate to temple step, crowd both sides, temple door dead centre at the end.

action: A soldier's eyes go along the roofline and the road, looking for a man nobody here has seen.
Rukmini looks straight ahead and at nothing, carried forward at somebody else's pace.
sound: The procession goes slightly out of sync with the picture here.

action: She comes out of the temple door with her friends behind her and stops on the threshold.
sound: Sound drops away across this cut, not on it.
nuke: Interior-to-exterior exposure shift held in-camera.

action: She breaks a vow of silence and says something, and the trailer does not let us hear it.
sound: Total silence. One breath. This is the quietest frame in the trailer.

action: She walks out among the kings who came for her, and goes past them as if they were furniture. One of them drops a cup.
sound: The cup is the only sound.
houdini: Rigid-body on the cup; wine.
nuke: Faces in the rank go soft as she passes — the inverse of T-03.

action: Her eyes are down on the stones. Then they lift.
sound: Nothing yet.

action: What she sees: a chariot at the edge of the forecourt, and the man in it, in full, for the first time in the film. The blue light arrives with him. Nobody says his name.
sound: One voice, unaccompanied, on a single syllable. Nothing else.
nuke: The entire grade of the trailer exists to make this frame read as a different kind of light. Hold the key cool, let the forecourt stay warm behind him.
staging: The chariot stands 18 m upstage at the forecourt edge, kings in two ranks either side of the gap. This is the one distance in the trailer that cannot be guessed.

action: Back to her, and what the sight has done to her face.
sound: The voice continues over the cut.

cast: Krishna; Rukmini; The coalition of kings
action: He does not wait for her to climb. He takes her up in front of every king there and sets her beside him; her foot leaves the ground.
sound: Full ensemble, in on the frame her foot leaves the stone.
houdini: Cloth and ornament sim through the lift.

cast: Krishna; Rukmini; Dāruka; Balarama; The coalition of kings
action: The chariot goes through the ring of kings the way a lion goes through jackals, and Balarama's men open the road in front of it.
sound: Hooves, wheels, and a conch over the top of it.
houdini: Dust, horses, crowd scatter.
staging: Ring of kings 30 m across with one gap; the chariot covers 25 m in the shot and leaves through it.

action: From the moving chariot, he says the only thing he says in this trailer, to the kings he is leaving behind.
dialogue: Krishna: Kings — she walked out on her own feet. I am only the chariot.
sound: Music under, not over.

action: The kings draw their swords too late. Behind the chariot a hundred horses turn at once.
sound: Steel, late.
houdini: Horse crowd turn; dust wall.

action: The conch, sounded once — and the trailer cuts to black on it.
sound: The conch runs two seconds past the cut, into the black.
nuke: Cut to black on the attack, not the release.

action: Title card. Black, scope frame, type only. Telugu title to be chosen — story/THE_STORY.md lists four candidates.
sound: The conch tail decays across the card. One struck bell at 1.5s.

action: The last line of the film, used as the button. If you would rather keep it for the film, the alternative button is her line 7 again, shortened to 'I am the one holding the pen.'
sound: No music. Room tone only, so the voice sounds like it is in the theatre.

action: Standard tail. Hold 2s; extend to 3s if a date is not yet locked.
sound: Silence.
